column1: # The Kilobyte Store: text-mode programs from Debian, chosen to fit Kilobyte.
# id|packages|command|category|name|description|flags
# flags: "pause" waits for a key when the program ends (for programs that
# print and stop); commands starting with kb-x open a graphics screen.
btop|btop|btop|Tools|System monitor (btop)|Processor, memory, disks and network at a glance|
ncdu|ncdu|ncdu ~|Tools|Disk usage (ncdu)|See what fills your folders, and clean up|
tmux|tmux|tmux|Tools|tmux|Several command lines in one terminal, side by side|
ranger|ranger|ranger|Tools|Ranger|A file manager with three columns and previews|
micro|micro|micro|Tools|Micro editor|An editor with the usual keys: Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+Q quits|
vim|vim|vim|Tools|Vim|The editor that is on every Unix computer|
emacs|emacs-nox|emacs -nw|Tools|Emacs|The extensible editor, in text mode|
lnav|lnav|lnav|Tools|Log viewer (lnav)|Read the system's logs with colours and search|
nload|nload|nload|Tools|Network load (nload)|How much is going in and out right now|
tig|tig|tig|Tools|tig|Browse the history of a Git project|

moc|moc|mocp|Media|MOC|Music on Console: a two-panel music player|

visidata|visidata|vd|Office|VisiData|Explore tables: CSV, Excel, JSON and more|
abook|abook|abook|Office|Address book (abook)|Names, addresses and phone numbers|
